capture_note: Live nested sub-agent span tree (#246), captured on 2.1.287 with the enhanced-telemetry beta against a loopback sink: `claude -p` with --allowedTools='Agent,Task,Read,Glob,Grep' asked the main session to use a project sub-agent (tiq-delegator, tools: Agent/Read/Glob) which in turn spawned a built-in Explore sub-agent. Observed shape: subagent_type rides only on the spawning claude_code.tool span (tool_name=Agent), which carries the SPAWNER's agent_id (absent when the main session spawns); the child's spans nest under that tool span's claude_code.tool.execution span; parent_agent_id is present on the grandchild's llm_request/tool spans only. The exporter's separate batches are merged into one payload in start-time order. Session/agent/tool/request/trace/span ids, organisation and user identity, file paths and the command line are replaced with synthetic values of the same shape; every attribute key, span parentage and numeric value is kept.
